Description.English:
Adds new Specialists focused on the DLC1 Content to Anno 117. REQUIRES DLC-1 Prophecies of Ashes! 
Info: You can currrently ignore the missing dependency. Mod is still loaded, as I don't know currently how to check for DLC. If you don't own the DLC you can hide this mod by renaming the Folder to <-DLC1-Pack> to hide & deactivate it in the mod manager.
Description.German:
Fügt neue Spezialisten mit Fokus auf Inhalte vom DLC1 zu Anno 117 hinzu. Benötigt DLC-1 Prophecies of Ashes! 
Info: Du kannst die fehlende Dependency-Warnung aktuell ignorieren, da ich aktuell noch nicht weiß wie das richtig nach dem DLC checkt. Die Mod lädt trotzdem. Falls du das DLC nicht besitzt, kannst du dieses Pack im Mod-Manager verstecken & deaktivieren indem der Ordner umbenannt wird zu < -DLC1-Pack >

CanSpawnAtAllTraders.label: Controlls if the Specialists can appear on basegame traders. Info: At other traders you pay with denarii. Not Obsidian. The price balance is not really given with basegame traders. You can increase the prices but then you might not be able to afford them at Caecilia. See TradePrice_Common for futher explaination on why.

FarmSpecialist_RespectObsidianDeposit.label: Controlls if the Specialist for gaining Obsidian via Farms, etc... requires an valid and some amount of obsidian deposit on the island

TradePrice_Common.label: Controlls the Tradeprice for Common Items. INFO: For Obsidian Costs multiply the value with: ~0.00595 and round it. Example 5000*0.00595=~30

ShrineDeity_Rare_BuffValue.label: Value for all Buff granted by Rare Shrine Specialists. Info: Value is Doubled for Deities only giving one Attribute (e.g Mercury's Shrine Buff)

ShrineDeity_Legendary_BuffValue_NonBoost.label: Value for all Buff granted by Legendary Shrine Specialists. Info: Value is Doubled for Deities only giving one Attribute (e.g Mercury's Shrine Buff)
